name: eos-mcp
description: Arista EOS device operations for Claude Code, via eAPI. Run show commands, retrieve and diff running-config, push config through a guarded configure-session with a commit timer, collect tech-support, and get a one-shot daily_brief fleet health check. Needs a local config.ini file (per-device eAPI username/password) — the server's only credential mechanism — already present at EOS_MCP_CONFIG or ~/.config/eos-mcp/config.ini; the plugin cannot create or supply that file for you, so every tool but health_check's config-status probe fails until it exists.
